blocks.text: You can customize the displayed columns and their sorting settings in tables throughout the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). This article explains how to add and remove the displayed columns, which include measurements (quantitative fields) and dimensions (categorical fields).
The Tickets page in Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) is shown as an example.
To add and remove columns from the table:

blocks.item: On an entity page in the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Settings icon.
The Manage Table Columns window appears, displaying columns currently in use on the right, and columns that can be added on the left.
To add a column, click the + icon on the field you want to add.
To remove a column, click the X icon on the field you want to remove.
Click Apply to save your changes.

blocks.text: You can also add or remove columns by dragging and dropping them in the window.

blocks.item: To add a field, drag it to the IN USE list.
To remove a field, drag it back to the AVAILABLE list.

blocks.text: Use the search box to find specific columns that you want to add or remove.

blocks.item: In the IN USE list, drag the columns in the order you want them to appear.
Click Apply to save your changes.

blocks.text: To sort a table by a column, click the column header you want to sort by. An arrow icon appears next to the column name, indicating the current sort direction (ascending or descending). Click the column header again to change the sort direction.
To undo the changes and revert to the default display, click Reset to Default and then click Apply.
